title: The Present Perfect (since, for, just, already, yet, ever, never)
summary: إزاي تستخدم have / has + V3 علشان تربط الماضي بالحاضر، ومعاه since / for / just / already / yet / ever / never، والفرق بينه وبين الماضي البسيط.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إيه؟

text: We use the **present perfect** (**have / has + past participle**) to talk about something that started or happened in the **past** and is still **important now**. It connects the past to the present, because we care about the **result**, not the exact time.

blocks.text: الـ **present perfect** (المضارع التام) هو الزمن اللي بيعمل **كوبري بين الماضي والحاضر**. حاجة حصلت قبل كده، بس **نتيجتها أو أثرها لسه موجود دلوقتي**، أو حاجة بدأت زمان **ولسه مستمرة**.

في الكتاب الدرس ده في **Unit 4: The Power of Choice**، Lesson 4.4 (عن الـ sales والـ **Black Friday**)، جزء **Grammar Focus** و**Grammar in Context** (صفحة 126-128)، ومعاه **Writing Task**: اكتب 5 جمل عن الـ sales culture بالـ present perfect، وبيرجع في **Consolidation Review B**. الكتاب بيقول إنه **منتشر جدًا في التقارير والمقالات والكتابة الأكاديمية**، وبيركز على الكلمات دي: **since, for, just, already, yet, never, ever**.
الفكرة ببساطة: النتيجة دلوقتي

text: Past simple = a finished action at a finished time (**yesterday, in 2010**). Present perfect = a past action with a **present result**, or a situation that is **still true** — the time is not finished or not important.

blocks.text: قارن الجملتين دول:

items.ar: Past simple: حكاية حصلت امبارح وخلصت. (يمكن لقيتها بعد كده.)
Present perfect: ضيعتها، و**النتيجة دلوقتي** إن معيش فلوس. مش مهم إمتى بالظبط.

blocks.text: فيه **4 استخدامات** رئيسية للـ present perfect:

rows: حاجة حصلت والأثر بتاعها باين النهارده
Food waste **has become** a serious problem.
بدأ في الماضي ولسه بيحصل لحد دلوقتي
Egypt **has faced** this issue **for** many years.
عملت الحاجة دي قبل كده في حياتك ولا لأ؟ (مش مهم إمتى)
**Have** you **ever fallen** for a loss aversion trick?
**4. حاجة حصلت حالًا أو مستنيينها (just / already / yet)**
حصلت من شوية / حصلت بدري عن المتوقع / لسه ما حصلتش

blocks.text: التكوين (Form)

text: **have / has + past participle (V3)**. Use **has** with he / she / it and singular nouns, **have** with I / you / we / they and plural nouns.

rows: Have you ever bought something you didn't need? — Yes, I **have**.
I've / we've / they've / he's / she's / it's
**She's** spent all her money. (she's هنا = she has)

blocks.text: الـ **V3 (past participle)** = التصريف التالت للفعل:

items: الأفعال **العادية (regular)**: نزوّد **-ed** زي التاني بالظبط: use ← used، waste ← wasted، introduce ← introduced، stop ← stopped، study ← studied.

الأفعال **الشاذة (irregular)** لازم تتحفظ: buy ← bought، spend ← spent، find ← found، become ← become، fall ← fallen، see ← seen، go ← gone، eat ← eaten، throw ← thrown، give ← given، take ← taken، write ← written، be ← been.

blocks.title: خلي بالك
blocks.text: **he's** ممكن تكون he **is** أو he **has**. لو بعدها V3 يبقى has: He's **bought** = He has bought. لو بعدها -ing أو صفة يبقى is: He's **buying** / He's **happy**.
الكلمات اللي بتيجي معاه: since, for, just, already, yet, ever, never

text: These **time markers** go in fixed positions. **just / already / ever / never** go between **have** and the V3. **yet** goes at the end. **since / for** usually go at the end.

rows: Scientists **have just published** new research on food waste.
Some schools **have already started** teaching food literacy.
The government **hasn't acted** on this problem **yet**. / **Have** you **paid yet**?
قبل كده؟ / في أي وقت (في حياتك)
بين subject و V3 في السؤال
**Have** you **ever bought** something just because it was on sale?
This topic **has never received** enough attention.
Food waste **has been** a problem **since** the 1990s.
Egypt **has faced** this issue **for** many years.

blocks.text: since ولا for؟

text: **since** + a **point** in time (when it started). **for** + a **period** of time (how long).

blocks.title: حيلة الفرق
items: اسأل: **من إمتى؟** ← since. **قد إيه؟** ← for.
لو بعدها **رقم + وحدة زمن** (two hours, ten years) ← غالبًا **for**.
بعد since ممكن ييجي **جملة في الماضي البسيط**: I have saved money **since I started** my budget.
سؤال المدة: **How long have** you **used** this app? — **For** two years. / **Since** 2024.

blocks.text: أهم فرق: Present Perfect ولا Past Simple؟

text: If the sentence has a **finished time** (**yesterday, last week, in 2019, two days ago, when I was ten**), use the **past simple**, not the present perfect.

blocks.text: ده أشهر سؤال في الامتحانات. القاعدة: **لو الوقت خلص ومذكور، استخدم الماضي البسيط**.

rows: وقت **خلص ومحدد**: yesterday, last year, in 2019, ago, when…
وقت **مش محدد** أو **لسه مخلصش**: ever, never, just, already, yet, since, for, so far, recently, this week, today
I **have bought** a jacket. (والنتيجة: عندي جاكيت جديد)
She **hasn't bought** anything **this week**. (الأسبوع لسه مخلصش)

items.en: ✗ I **have bought** these shoes **two days ago**. ← ✓ I **bought** these shoes **two days ago**.
✓ I **have bought** these shoes, and I **wore** them **yesterday**.
items.ar: الأول: نتيجة دلوقتي (عندي الجزمة). التاني: حدث بوقت محدد (امبارح).

blocks.text: وبالنسبة لمثال الكتاب **She has bought a jacket during the sale**: ده صح لأن الـ sale **لسه شغال** (الفترة مخلصتش). لو الـ sale خلص وبنحكي عنه كحكاية، نقول: She **bought** a jacket during **last week's** sale.
been ولا gone؟

text: **has gone to** = went and is still there. **has been to** = went and came back (experience).

items.ar: أحمد راح المول **ولسه هناك** (مش موجود دلوقتي).

items.en: Ahmed **has been** to the mall three times this month.
**Have** you ever **been** to a Black Friday sale?
items.ar: عمرك رحت أوكازيون Black Friday؟ (been مع ever).

blocks.text: أمثلة من موضوعات الوحدة
الأمثلة دي عن موضوعات Unit 4: الـ brands، الـ food waste، الـ sales والـ Black Friday، والـ screen time.

items.en: Food waste **has become** a serious global problem in recent years.
items.ar: إهدار الأكل بقى مشكلة عالمية خطيرة في السنين الأخيرة. نتيجة دلوقتي. (Review B)

items.en: Research **has found** that sale shoppers spend more money overall.
items.ar: الأبحاث لقت إن اللي بيشتروا في الأوكازيونات بيصرفوا أكتر. نتيجة بحث لسه مهمة.
المحلات بتستخدم عدادات التنازل بقالها سنين. for + مدة.

items.en: Many families **have started** planning their meals **since** prices went up.
items.ar: عائلات كتير بدأت تخطط لأكلها من ساعة ما الأسعار غليت.

items.en: I **have never bought** a jacket just because it was 50% off.
items.ar: عمري ما اشتريت جاكيت علشان عليه خصم 50% بس. never + فعل مثبت.

items.en: **Have** you **ever fallen** for a loss aversion trick?
items.ar: عمرك اتخدعت بخدعة الـ loss aversion قبل كده؟ ever في السؤال.

items.en: The supermarket **has just launched** a campaign against food waste.
items.ar: السوبرماركت لسه حالًا طلع حملة ضد إهدار الأكل.

items.en: We **have already spent** half of our monthly budget.
items.ar: إحنا صرفنا خلاص نص ميزانية الشهر (وإحنا لسه في نصه).

items.en: My brother **hasn't deleted** the shopping app **yet**.
items.ar: أخويا لسه ما مسحش أبليكيشن الشوبينج. yet في آخر جملة النفي.

items.en: Teenagers **have spent** more time on screens **since** the pandemic.
items.ar: المراهقين بقوا يقضوا وقت أكتر على الشاشات من ساعة الوباء.

items.en: This topic **has never received** enough attention.
items.ar: الموضوع ده عمره ما خد الاهتمام الكافي. (زي جملة الكتاب)

blocks.text: إزاي نستخدمه في التقارير والمقالات

text: In reports and opinion articles, the present perfect presents **recent findings** and **changes** that matter now: **Studies have shown…, Prices have risen…, Consumers have become…**

blocks.text: في الـ opinion article أو الـ formal report بتاع الوحدة، الـ present perfect بيخلي كلامك **حديث ومهم**. استخدمه علشان تقدّم **الدليل (Evidence)** في الـ JRE:

text: **Justify:** Sales events do not really help consumers save money. **Reason:** Shops **have designed** clever tricks such as countdown clocks and 'Only 3 left!' signs. **Evidence:** Research **has found** that people who shop during sales spend more overall. In Egypt, many young people **have started** buying online because apps **have made** shopping faster than ever.

blocks.text: لاحظ: has found / have designed / have started بيقولوا إن الكلام ده **حصل ولسه ليه أثر النهارده**. وده بيقوّي الحجة.

blocks.title: أشهر الأخطاء (غلط ← صح)
items: ✗ She **have** bought a jacket. ← ✓ She **has** bought a jacket. (she = has)
✗ She has **buy** / **buyed** a jacket. ← ✓ She has **bought** a jacket. (V3 الشاذ)
✗ Shops **has** used countdown clocks. ← ✓ Shops **have** used… (جمع = have)
✗ Shops have **use** / **using** countdown clocks. ← ✓ have **used**.
✗ **You have ever** fallen for a trick? ← ✓ **Have you ever fallen** for a trick? (السؤال يبدأ بـ Have)
✗ Have you ever **fall**? ← ✓ Have you ever **fallen**?
✗ I have **never not** bought… / I **haven't never**… ← ✓ I have **never** bought… (never نفي لوحدها)
✗ I have already finished it **yet**. ← ✓ I have **already** finished it. / I **haven't** finished it **yet**.
✗ I have lived here **since** five years. ← ✓ **for** five years.
✗ I **have seen** that advert **yesterday**. ← ✓ I **saw** that advert yesterday.

blocks.title: إزاي تجاوب بسرعة في الامتحان
items: دوّر على **الكلمة الدليل**: since / for / just / already / yet / ever / never / recently / so far ← present perfect.
لو لقيت **yesterday / ago / last / in + سنة فاتت** ← past simple.
اتأكد من **has** مع المفرد و**have** مع الجمع، وإن الفعل **V3**.
**yet** = نفي أو سؤال وفي الآخر. **already** = مثبت وفي النص.

blocks.text: إزاي بييجي في الأسئلة؟
الأسئلة في الكتاب والمراجعات بتيجي بالأشكال دي. هنحل مثال لكل شكل:
**1) Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d.**

text: My brother hasn't paid for his online order ______.
a. already  b. since  c. yet  d. ever

blocks.text: **الإجابة: c. yet** — جملة نفي (hasn't paid) والكلمة في الآخر.
**2) Write the correct present perfect form of the verbs between brackets.**

text: Some schools in Egypt (already / start) teaching food education.

blocks.text: **الإجابة:** Some schools **have already started** — schools جمع = have، already بين have والـ V3.
**3) Only one sentence in each group is grammatically correct. Choose the correct answer.**

text: a. Prices have risen since three years.
b. Prices has risen for three years.
c. Prices have risen for three years.
d. Prices have rose for three years.

blocks.text: **الإجابة: c.** prices جمع = have، V3 بتاع rise هو risen، و«three years» مدة = for.
تدريب
**A. Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d.**

items.q:
1. Online shopping ______ very popular among teenagers in recent years.
a. has become  b. became  c. have become  d. becomes
items.a: **a. has become** — in recent years = لحد دلوقتي، و online shopping مفرد = has.

items.q:
2. I ______ my pocket money on clothes last weekend.
a. have spent  b. spent  c. has spent  d. have spend
items.a: **b. spent** — last weekend = وقت خلص، يبقى past simple.

items.q:
3. The company has ______ launched its new phone, so it is not in the shops yet.
a. yet  b. never  c. just  d. since
items.a: **c. just** — لسه حالًا نزّلته (علشان كده مش في المحلات لسه).

items.q:
4. Have you ______ bought something only because of a countdown clock?
a. yet  b. ever  c. already  d. since
items.a: **b. ever** — سؤال عن الخبرة في الحياة.

items.q:
5. My family has used this supermarket ______ 2018.
a. for  b. since  c. ago  d. during
items.a: **b. since** — 2018 نقطة بداية.

items.q:
6. The government hasn't introduced new food waste laws ______.
a. already  b. just  c. yet  d. ever
items.a: **c. yet** — نفي، وفي الآخر.

items.q:
7. Shops ______ this trick for decades.
a. has used  b. have used  c. used to using  d. have using
items.a: **b. have used** — shops جمع، و for decades مدة لسه مستمرة.

items.q:
8. Nour isn't here. She ______ to the mall with her friends.
a. has been  b. has gone  c. have gone  d. was gone
items.a: **b. has gone** — راحت ولسه هناك (isn't here).

blocks.text: **B. Only one sentence in each group is grammatically correct. Choose the correct answer.**

items.q:
9. a. Nour has spent all her pocket money.
b. Nour have spent all her pocket money.
c. Nour has spend all her pocket money.
d. Nour has spended all her pocket money.
items.a: **a** — Nour (هي) = has، و V3 بتاع spend هو spent.

items.q:
10. a. You have ever bought something you didn't need?
b. Have you ever buy something you didn't need?
c. Did you ever have bought something you didn't need?
d. Have you ever bought something you didn't need?
items.a: **d** — السؤال: Have + subject + ever + V3 (bought).

items.q:
11. a. I have never wasted so much food before.
b. I haven't never wasted so much food before.
c. I have never waste so much food before.
d. I has never wasted so much food before.
items.a: **a** — never لوحدها نفي، ومعاها فعل مثبت V3.

items.q:
12. a. We have watched that advert two days ago.
b. We watched that advert two days ago.
c. We has watched that advert two days ago.
d. We have watch that advert two days ago.
items.a: **b** — ago = past simple.

blocks.text: **C. Write the correct present perfect form of the verbs between brackets.**

items.q: 13. Researchers (discover) that bread is the food Egyptian families waste most.
items.a: **have discovered** — researchers جمع = have.

items.q: 14. The restaurant (not / start) donating its leftover food yet.
items.a: **hasn't started** — restaurant مفرد، نفي مع yet.

items.q: 15. My sister (just / cancel) her online order.
items.a: **has just cancelled** — just بين has و V3. (cancelled بـ ll في البريطاني)

items.q: 16. (you / ever / try) to go a whole week without buying anything?
items.a: **Have you ever tried** — سؤال خبرة: Have + you + ever + V3.

items.q: 17. We (know) about the dangers of fast fashion for many years.
items.a: **have known** — for many years = مستمر لحد دلوقتي. (know فعل حالة، فمش بنقول have been knowing)

items.q: 18. Black Friday (become) popular in Egypt since online shopping grew.
items.a: **has become** — since + جملة في الماضي البسيط.

blocks.text: **D. Complete, correct and write.**

items.q: 19. Complete with since or for: I have followed this brand ______ I was twelve, and I have worn its trainers ______ three years.
items.a: **since** I was twelve (نقطة بداية) / **for** three years (مدة).

items.q: 20. Find and correct the mistake: The app has already sent me ten notifications yet.
items.a: نشيل **yet**: The app has already sent me ten notifications. — yet مش بتيجي في المثبت.

items.q: 21. Find and correct the mistake: How long do you have this phone?
items.a: **How long have you had** this phone? — سؤال المدة لحاجة لسه مستمرة = present perfect.

items.q: 22. Rewrite using the present perfect: I started using a shopping list in January. I still use it.
items.a: I **have used** a shopping list **since** January. — أو: I have used a shopping list **for** … months.

items.q: 23. Answer with a full sentence: Have you ever thrown away food that you didn't eat?
items.a: مثال: Yes, I **have**. I **have thrown away** bread many times. / No, I **have never thrown away** food.

items.q: 24. Write TWO sentences about food waste: one with already and one with yet.
items.a: مثال: Some hotels **have already started** giving leftover food to charities. Many families **haven't learnt** to plan their meals **yet**.

items.q: 25. Write FIVE sentences about sales culture using the present perfect (as in the book's Writing Task). Use five different time markers.
items.a: مثال: Shops **have used** countdown clocks **for** years. Prices **have risen** **since** last Ramadan. I **have just seen** a '70% off' sign. **Have** you **ever** bought something you didn't need? I **have never** waited all night for a sale. — for / since / just / ever / never.

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: Present perfect = **have / has + V3**: حاجة حصلت **ونتيجتها لسه مهمة دلوقتي**، أو بدأت زمان **ولسه مستمرة**.
**has** مع he / she / it والمفرد، **have** مع I / you / we / they والجمع.
**just / already / ever / never** بين have والـ V3، و**yet** في آخر النفي والسؤال.
**since** + نقطة بداية (2020)، **for** + مدة (ten years).
لو فيه **yesterday / ago / last / in 2019** يبقى **past simple** مش present perfect.
